# NFL Daily — 2026-11-22 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Tom Jackson, a cornerstone of the Broncos' "Orange Crush" defense and longtime ESPN NFL Countdown co-host, has died at 75. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50561778/tom-jackson-broncos-star-espn-legend-dies-75)
- The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after rejecting an earlier Ravens trade offer (a 4th-round pick plus a conditional 5th); the Patriots and Ravens are among the suitors once he clears waivers Monday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50557657/sources-daniel-jones-likely-wait-joining-new-team) — also [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/patriots-ravens-suitors-daniel-jones-following-colts-release)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua is out for the rest of the season, including the playoffs, after MCL surgery with a 4-to-5-month recovery timeline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50556613/sources-rams-puka-nacua-4-5-months-knee-surgery)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons is on track to come off the PUP list and make his season debut in Week 12 against the Rams. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/micah-parsons-acl-injury-update-packers-rams)
- The Colts are shutting down WR Alec Pierce for the rest of the season, with plans to have him healthy for 2027. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50551004/sources-colts-shutting-alec-pierce-rest-season)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Patriots QB Drake Maye (fractured right fibula) is expected to miss at least six weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Raiders TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is inactive again for Week 11. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2124592834716053525)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-22 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after turning down a Ravens trade offer at the deadline (a 4th-round pick plus a conditional 5th); Baltimore is now among the suitors to sign him once he clears waivers Monday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50557657/sources-daniel-jones-likely-wait-joining-new-team) — also [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/patriots-ravens-suitors-daniel-jones-following-colts-release)
- CB Marlon Humphrey was deactivated and sent home ahead of Sunday's game at Carolina following his "criminals" comment about Baltimore. [Wacker](https://x.com/brianwacker1/status/2124555042556383504)
- RB Derrick Henry appeared woozy and was taken to the medical tent after scoring a go-ahead touchdown late in the fourth quarter against the Panthers; Baltimore led 33-32 with 6:32 remaining. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2124607684489904235)
